design_philosophy.art_direction: Bold cohesive art direction leaning into an 'Awwwards-level' premium aesthetic for home services. We are elevating installation and repair services into a high-end, luxury technical experience.
key_elements: Large kinetic hero with masked line-by-line on-load reveal.
Real product photography treated deliberately with dark navy overlays and amber accents.
Numbered manifesto chapters to build trust and authority.
One slow editorial marquee for service list.
Premium motion with framer-motion scroll reveals and micro-interactions.
Lenis smooth scrolling for weight and premium feel.

headings.styles: Tight letter spacing (tracking-tight), never centered by default, bold and technical. Use fluid scaling.

body.styles: Clean, highly readable, loose line height (leading-relaxed).

accents_labels.styles: Uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs or text-sm, often in amber/gold.

typography.custom_fonts_instructions: Add Cabinet Grotesk via Fontshare API in index.html: <link href="https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=cabinet-grotesk@800,500,700,900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism (The 'Crystal' Variant) for Sticky Nav: bg-[#0A1121]/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10. Dashboard/Bento cards use flat backgrounds with 1px border-white/10 and NO shadow. On hover, translate-y-[-4px] and subtle glow.
visual_enhancers.gradients: NO generic full-screen gradients. Use localized soft radial glows behind key elements in #E5A93C with 10% opacity.
visual_enhancers.overlays: Hero images must use bg-black/40 overlay to ensure text contrast while letting the image breathe.
visual_enhancers.marquee: The 'Editorial Ribbon' - Slow moving, subtle. Dark Navy background, Pale grey or Gold outline text, font-serif or clean sans, massive gaps.
visual_enhancers.grid_borders: The 'Technical' Look - Expose the grid skeleton in the services section using border-collapse style layouts with 1px borders.

components_and_layouts.hero_section: Kinetic Masked Reveal. H1 text uses Framer Motion overflow-hidden and y-axis translation. Subtle parallax on the background image. Overlay dark navy gradient.
components_and_layouts.services_grid: Bento Grid Protocol. Asymmetrical layout mixing spans (e.g., col-span-2 row-span-2 for primary services, col-span-1 for minor repairs). Minimalist cards, sharp edges or max 4px radius.
components_and_layouts.numbered_manifesto: Large typography numbers (01, 02, 03) in gold, paired with strong benefit-driven copy. Staggered reveal on scroll.
components_and_layouts.gallery_section: Masonry or overlapping card layout. Real photos. On hover, slight scale-up of image with a glassmorphism caption appearing.
components_and_layouts.contact_form: Shadcn-based form, heavily customized. Dark inputs (bg-white/5), sharp borders (border-white/10), Gold submit button. Include WhatsApp floating action button fixed to bottom right.

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scrolling: Lenis is MANDATORY. Initialize in App.js or main layout wrapper.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveals: Use framer-motion for whileInView staggered fades and slight Y translations. Elements should feel like they 'land' softly.
motion_and_interactions.hero_kinetic: Text split into lines. Each line wrapped in a hidden overflow container. Framer motion animate y from 100% to 0%.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Interactive elements must transition colors and slightly translate. High contrast on focus.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion in Framer Motion configurations.

hero_image.description: Stylish urban house representing premium home services.

media_and_images.image_rules: All images MUST be used. Ensure images in bento grids have overlay gradients to maintain text legibility. Hero images MUST use a dark overlay (bg-black/40 or bg-[#050A14]/60) so the premium gold text stands out.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install specific dependencies: `yarn add framer-motion @phosphor-icons/react react-fast-marquee @studio-freight/lenis`.
This is a premium React SPA. Ensure React Router is configured with 5 distinct pages.

The client specifically requested 'Award-worthy Awwwards-level design'. Do NOT use standard Vercel/Stripe boilerplate. Use large dramatic typography, vast negative space (p-12 to p-32), and strict grid alignments.
Do not center-align the main layout. Left-align large typographic elements for an editorial feel.
Navigation: Create a glassmorphic sticky top nav. It must not be completely transparent.
Floating Action Button: Include a fixed WhatsApp button (bottom-right) linking to 0730526871 across all routes.
Hero Section: Implement the kinetic text reveal. Wrap text lines in an overflow-hidden span and use framer-motion to slide them up on mount.
Marquee: Use `react-fast-marquee` in the Home page for a slow-moving list of services. Style it with the outline text technique: text-transparent webkit-text-stroke-1 stroke-white/20.
Grid Layouts: Use the Bento Grid Protocol for the services section. Use varied row and col spans to break the monotony.
Testing: Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states.
